changeSet.author: eduardo.sakae
changeSet.sql: UPDATE fpdi_budget_element target_be JOIN ( SELECT be.id AS budget_element_id, COUNT(b.id) AS num_links_desativados FROM fpdi_budget_element be JOIN fpdi_budget b ON b.budgetElement_id = be.id JOIN fpdi_structure_level_instance sli ON sli.id = b.levelInstance_id JOIN fpdi_plans p ON p.id = sli.plan_id JOIN fpdi_plan_macro pm ON pm.id = p.parent_id WHERE pm.deleted = 1 AND b.deleted = 0 GROUP BY be.id ) AS counts ON target_be.id = counts.budget_element_id SET target_be.linkedObjects = target_be.linkedObjects - counts.num_links_desativados;

UPDATE fpdi_budget_element target_be JOIN ( SELECT be.id AS budget_element_id, SUM(IFNULL(b.committed, 0)) AS total_committed_to_revert FROM fpdi_budget_element be JOIN fpdi_budget b ON b.budgetElement_id = be.id JOIN fpdi_structure_level_instance sli ON sli.id = b.levelInstance_id JOIN fpdi_plans p ON p.id = sli.plan_id JOIN fpdi_plan_macro pm ON pm.id = p.parent_id WHERE pm.deleted = 1 AND b.deleted = 0 AND b.committed IS NOT NULL AND b.committed != 0 GROUP BY be.id ) AS sums ON target_be.id = sums.budget_element_id SET target_be.balanceAvailable = target_be.balanceAvailable + sums.total_committed_to_revert;

UPDATE fpdi_budget b JOIN fpdi_structure_level_instance sli ON sli.id = b.levelInstance_id JOIN fpdi_plans p ON p.id = sli.plan_id JOIN fpdi_plan_macro pm ON pm.id = p.parent_id SET b.deleted = 1, b.committed = 0 WHERE pm.deleted = 1 AND b.deleted = 0;
changeSet.comment: Esta migration corrige inconsistências na base de dados relacionadas a elementos de orçamento. 1. Atualiza o campo linkedObjects em fpdi_budget_element diminuindo o número de links desativados 2. Atualiza o campo balanceAvailable em fpdi_budget_element adicionando os valores comprometidos a serem revertidos 3. Marca como excluídos (deleted=1) e zera os valores comprometidos (committed=0) em registros fpdi_budget associados a planos excluídos
